newsitem.title: INDIA: India's lower house extends direct rule in UP.
newsitem.headline: India's lower house extends direct rule in UP.

text.p: The lower house of India's parliament voted on Friday to extend president's rule in Uttar Pradesh for six months beyond April 17, parliamentary officials said.
The Lok Sabha approved the resolution to extend direct federal rule over the northern state by voice vote after members of the opposition Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) walked out.
New Delhi's current six-month authority to rule over India's most populous state expires on April 17. Local elections last year yielded a hung state assembly.
The resolution was sent to the upper house, the Rajya Sabha, for consideration, officials said.
